name: Twilight of the Mind
body:
School illusion (pattern) [darkness, mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, legendary ninja 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the area to fill with a shadowy twilight that shifts and moves confusing the observer and leaves them doubting their senses. The area becomes dim light and all creatures within the area of the spell take a -10 penalty on Perception and Sense Motive skill checks. A successful Will save negates the penalties of the spell but not the dim light effect.
